```plato
    // The apex on the far side of an edge; the "none" index on a boundary edge.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Typed indices (-1 means "none").
    EdgeFarApex(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): VertexIndex
    {
        var twin = topology.CornerTwins[topology.EdgeCorners[edge.Value].Value];
        return twin.IsNone ? VertexIndex(-1) : self.CornerVertex(PreviousCorner(twin));
    }
```
